summary: Small gravel lot under trees, but a house sits just south.
reasons: House about 15 m from north end
Gravel lot backs onto trees and park
Small: room for two or three vehicles

drivers.seclusion: Trees and parkland to north and west; detached house 6 m from south end, roughly 15 m from north end.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel apron meets the road edge; two cars parked in it, room for a van at the top.
drivers.traffic: 40 km/h road with kerbside cars; van stands off the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars park in the lot and along the road; looks like overflow parking.

flags: House on the same side within about 15 m of best section
Cars parked in lot may leave little room
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the north end, mostly from the north and east.
cannot_judge: Time limits or signs on site
Whether the house overlooks the north end

best_section.where: North end of the small gravel lot, furthest from the house to the south
